commit.message: fix(ci): rebase behind-main PRs on the merge event, not only hourly

intent: Close the merge-flow stall the operator hits on every merge: a merge to main puts every other open PR behind, and with require-up-to-date branch protection those PRs cannot merge until something rebases them. pr-ci-health's rebase sweep ran only on the hourly cron, so the wait was up to 59 minutes and the operator hand-tapped Update branch on each PR, restarting full CI every time. Add a push:[main] trigger running the sweep in rebase mode so the merge event is answered in about a minute and armed auto-merges drain unattended.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import subprocess,sys; from pathlib import Path; p=Path('.github/workflows/pr-ci-health.yml'); orig=p.read_text(); mut=orig.replace('  push:\n    branches: [main]\n', ''); assert mut!=orig; p.write_text(mut); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','tests/test_pr_ci_health.py','-q'],check=False); p.write_text(orig); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode!=0 else 2)"
negative_controls.name: dropping-push-trigger-breaks-contract-test

honest_blockers: This trigger only helps PRs the safe-rebase tool will actually touch. pr_ci_safe_rebase.py:331-342 skips any PR that changes a Session Entry packet or a .github/workflows file, so hot-path PRs (which carry both) still require a manual branch update. Removing that exclusion is NOT attempted here: the packet guard protects base_ref custody and the workflow guard avoids a push the token may lack scope for.

The structural fix for the excluded PRs is a merge queue (GitHub updates+tests+merges without rewriting the PR branch, so neither guard applies) or clearing require-branches-up-to-date. Both need an operator settings change; the merge_group triggers would also touch titanium-owned workflow files.
This PR is itself an excluded PR (workflow + packet), so it will need one manual branch update if main moves before it merges.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the single commit; the workflow returns to the hourly-only cron. No state is touched.
